cover.hook: Instagram can now flag people who repost your Reels. Are you in?
cover.label: 5 social updates worth knowing right now

slides.headline: Instagram will [[flag copies]] of your Reels
slides.sub: New content protection scans for reposts of your videos. You can block a match, add an original by label, or leave it up and track it.

slides.headline: shoppable products per Reel with [[Amazon links]]
slides.sub: Creators can tag up to 30 products per Reel and 20 per feed post, and see the commission rate for each. Needs a linked Amazon Influencer account.

slides.headline: in creator ad spend [[expected this year]]
slides.sub: The IAB says creator budgets are up from $13.9 billion in 2021, more than tripling in five years.

slides.headline: countries get AI clips for [[podcast Shorts]]
slides.sub: YouTube Studio can turn a 16:9 podcast segment into a vertical Short with auto captions. AI-suggested segments cover 10 countries, including the US.
slides.source: YouTube Help, via PPC Land, Nov 12

slides.headline: is the deadline for [[extra profiles]]
slides.sub: Meta will permanently remove additional Facebook profiles after Dec 14, 2026. Export your data and reassign any group admin roles first.

take.headline: Own your content, then [[make it pay]]
take.sub: Protection, affiliate links and clips all reward original work. Audit what you post and where it earns.

cta.headline: Comment [[UPDATE]] and I'll send you the full list
cta.sub: All five updates, with the sources, in one place.

stories.name: story-thu
stories.headline: Edits adds [[speed curves]]
stories.sub: Meta's Edits app now lets you vary playback speed inside a clip with presets or your own curve, and it can balance audio automatically.

stories.name: story-fri
stories.headline: Would you let AI [[clip your podcast]] into Shorts?
stories.context: YouTube Studio now turns podcast segments into vertical Shorts.

stories.name: story-sat
stories.headline: X adds [[native clipping]]
stories.sub: Clips carry a Clip from label, and payouts are shared between the original creator and the person who clipped it.

stories.name: story-sun
stories.headline: LinkedIn brings [[TV ads]] to the UK
stories.sub: B2B targeting on streaming TV across LG, Paramount+ and Titan OS. The 30% lower lead cost figure is LinkedIn's own claim.

stories.name: story-mon
stories.headline: Will you add [[affiliate links]] to your Reels?
stories.context: Instagram now supports Amazon affiliate links on Reels and posts.

stories.name: story-tue
stories.headline: Check your [[group admins]] on Facebook
stories.sub: If an extra profile runs a group, assign a main profile as admin before Dec 14 or the group is paused.

stories.name: story-wed
stories.headline: Try one [[new tool]] this week
stories.sub: Clips, speed curves or affiliate links. Pick one, test it on a real post, and note what you learn.
